title: Say Now enters a new era with debut EP 'Say what you see'

blocks.text: Amelia, Maddie and Ysabelle, collectively known as British girl group Say Now, have released their debut EP, ‘Say what you see’, alongside their brand-new single, “Girl of the moment”, via Atlantic Records on 13 November 2026. Fans can stream the album here and watch the visualiser here. “Girl of the moment” serves as the third single from the group’s six-track debut EP, ‘Say what you see’. All six tracks on the EP were co-written by the band and PinkPantheress, who also executive produced the project, marking an exciting new chapter in Say Now’s musical journey.
